text:
Megan: quick follow-up to the rollout RFC: proposing a decision-hub microservice to aggregate model signals and emit a small verdict bundle for the rollout controller.
Raj: question - hub or controller? is this just aggregation or does it arbitrate?
Megan: aggregation only. hub emits verdict objects + stability score. controller still decides actions.
Sara: we need anti-flap measures. last month's token-nll spike caused oscillation.
Megan: plan: consensus window (rolling), trimmed-mean, and a 'stickiness' requirement (k consecutive failing windows) before action.
Kaz: what's the producer contract? CI, offline evals, probes - how do they publish signals?
Megan: minimal producer schema: metric_map, probe_status, labeled_delta, drift_index. we'll publish a tiny SDK.
Raj: latency concerns - hub mustn't become a sync blocker. use cached verdicts & async aggregation.
Megan: default async + cached TTL; synchronous mode allowed but must be declared in rollout config.
Sara: fallback granularity - can we prefer soft-degrades (smaller model, then quantized) instead of blanket rollbacks?
Megan: yes. controller supports a fallback ladder; hub can recommend a rung based on failure reason.
Kaz: ownership - who owns truth sets & probes?
Megan: ML teams own probes. platform provides probe runner + storage and owns decision-hub runtime + audit trails.
DeployBot: hook added: POST /api/internal/rollout/decision-hub for svc/cart
Raj: observability - need per-canary raw-signal archive + verdict audit for 90d default.
Megan: agreed. 90d default, enterprise opt-in for longer. surface timelines in console.
Sara: tuning thresholds - avoid biasing toward conservative rollbacks. suggest calibration cohorts where hub only records verdicts for N% traffic and controller ignores during calibration.
Megan: introducing calibration_cohort mode - non-actionable verdicts collected for analysis and threshold tuning.
Kaz: failure semantics - hub outage shouldn't block rollouts. default fail-open but allow fail-closed per-canary when customer requests.
Megan: default fail-open + alerting. fail-closed allowed via rollout config with enterprise review.
Raj: add a strict timeout contract for verdict freshness and a backstop metric for SRE auto-evacuation.
Megan: will add SLAs. next step: eng-ml drafts producer schema + example probes; eng-platform drafts hub API and authn; eng-sre writes runbook.
Kaz: sample producer snippet:
```
{
  metric_map: {rouge: 0.41, em: 0.88},
  drift_index: 0.12,
  labeled_delta: -0.03,
  probes: {smoke: pass, sanity: pass}
}
```
Raj: please include docs for stability_window, stickiness_k, confidence_threshold, and fallback_preferences in the RFC.
Megan: will do. tagging eng-ml, eng-platform, eng-sre for review.
Kaz: 👍
Sara: :thumbsup:
